reconcile.note: Gill denies the Catholic Limbus reading of Peter's letter, insisting Christ's soul went straight to paradise rather than descending to any prison.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "Where did Jesus go when he died?" (1999).

sides.snippet: today you will be with me in Paradise
sides.verseText: Jesus said to him, \"Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.\"

sides.snippet: in which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
